Method of Attack: Ransomware encryptor used for encrypting victim files
Selling stolen data before encryption to other threat actors
Leaking stolen data as password-protected RAR archives and releasing passwords if ransom not paid
Exploiting CVE-2022-29499 remote code execution vulnerability in Mitel MiVoice VOIP appliances for initial access
Using reverse shell and Chisel tunneling tool to pivot into environment
Impacted Systems: Mitel Service Appliance component of MiVoice Connect
Organizations using Mitel Voice-over-IP products including government agencies
Attack Vector: Exploitation of CVE-2022-29499 vulnerability in Mitel appliances over the Internet
Initial access via compromised Mitel VOIP phone systems
Indicators of Compromise: Over 19,000 Mitel devices exposed to attacks over the Internet
Use of reverse shell and Chisel tunneling tool
Password-protected RAR archives containing stolen data
Public release of passwords to leaked archives if ransom not paid
